description: Removes every participant of a signature request that the platform has marked invalid, in one call. Requires: signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId. signature_participant_list identifies them via `valid: false` and `validationError` — typically an undeliverable email or a malformed phone number. Returns no body; confirm with signature_participant_list. Prefer signature_participant_update when the detail can be repaired rather than the person dropped.
name: signature_participant_invalid_purge
